site.anchor: incide a diminuição do art. 121, § 1º

source.quote: Se o agente comete o crime impelido por motivo de relevante valor social ou moral, ou sob o domínio de violenta emoção, logo em seguida a injusta provocação da vítima, o juiz pode reduzir a pena de um sexto a um terço.

readings.description: § 1º applies to a qualified homicide only where the qualifying circumstance is about the means or the victim (§ 2º III, IV, VII, VIII, IX, X), not where it is itself a motive or a purpose (§ 2º I, II, V, and § 2º-D's 'no contexto ... ou para a consecução').

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 1º — 'Se o agente comete o crime', not only the simple homicide
CP art. 121, § 2º, I, II and V — each a motive or purpose, which a motive of relevant social or moral value cannot coexist with

readings.description: § 1º applies alongside every qualifying circumstance.
readings.rejection_rationale: A killing cannot be at once for a motive of relevant social or moral value and for a torpe or fútil motive, or to secure another crime: the motives exclude each other, so the reading gives § 1º to facts it cannot describe.

readings.description: § 1º reduces only the simple homicide, because it stands before § 2º.
readings.rejection_rationale: The paragraph says 'o crime', not 'o homicídio simples'; its place before § 2º says nothing about its reach, and no word of § 2º excludes it.

taken.rationale: It is the only reading that neither applies § 1º to facts it cannot describe nor confines it by position. It is the common understanding of the 'homicídio qualificado-privilegiado'; no authority was fetched, so it is recorded as the encoder's reading.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `por relevante valor, com meio cruel` (reduced) and `por relevante valor e por motivo fútil` (not)

site.anchor: diminuição do art. 121, § 1º

source.quote: o juiz pode reduzir a pena de um sexto a um terço

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 5º — 'o juiz poderá deixar de aplicar a pena'
CP art. 129, § 5º — 'pode ainda substituir a pena de detenção pela de multa'

readings.description: Once the findings are made (the motive, the violent emotion after an unjust provocation), the reduction of §§ 1º and 4º is a cause the judge must apply, choosing only the fraction within 1/6 to 1/3; the pardon (§ 5º, § 8º) and the substitution (§ 5º of art. 129) are powers, returned as options.

citations.cite: CP art. 68 — the causes of decrease are the third phase

readings.description: 'pode' leaves the judge free not to reduce even with the findings made, so §§ 1º and 4º are options like § 5º, not causes.

taken.rationale: The findings §§ 1º and 4º turn on are the jury's and the judge's to make, and the encoding takes them as inputs; once they are made, treating the reduction as still optional would let the same findings yield two penalties. Either way the encoding never picks the fraction. The pardon and the substitution stay options, because their words ('poderá deixar de aplicar', 'pode substituir') name an act, not a quantity.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `por relevante valor moral` — the reduction is listed
cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `grave, sob violenta emoção`
notes: The reading follows g0's F-g0-27 on art. 155 § 2º, which took the privilege as the defendant's right once its requirements are met.

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 121, § 4º, segunda parte

source.quote: Sendo doloso o homicídio, a pena é aumentada de 1/3 (um terço) se o crime é praticado contra pessoa menor de 14 (quatorze) ou maior de 60 (sessenta) anos.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º, IX — 'contra menor de 14 (quatorze) anos' (Lei nº 14.344/2022)

readings.description: Since § 2º IX made the victim's age under fourteen a qualifying circumstance, § 4º's increase for a victim under fourteen does not apply to the homicide it already qualifies; the increase stays for the victim over sixty.
Both apply: IX qualifies the homicide (12 to 30 years) and § 4º increases it by a third, because the later law did not amend § 4º.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 4º — unamended by Lei nº 14.344/2022

taken.rationale: The same fact — the victim's age — would be counted twice, once to qualify and once to increase. Counting one circumstance once is the general rule of sentencing (the qualifying circumstance and the cause of increase must rest on different facts). No authority on this pair was fetched.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `Helena aos 13` — qualified, no § 4º increase

site.anchor: o crime de matar que os fatos constituem (arts. 121 a 121-B)

source.quote: Art. 121-B. Matar descendente, ascendente, dependente, enteado ou pessoa sob guarda ou responsabilidade direta da mulher, com o fim específico de causar-lhe sofrimento, punição ou controle, no contexto de violência doméstica e familiar.

citations.cite: CP art. 121-A, caput — 'Matar mulher por razões da condição do sexo feminino'

readings.description: A killing that makes out both art. 121-A and art. 121-B (a woman killed to punish another woman, in a setting of domestic violence that also gives her own killing the razões of art. 121-A § 1º) is governed by art. 121-B; either special article displaces art. 121.

citations.cite: CP art. 121-B — the vicarious purpose is the more specific element

readings.description: Art. 121-A governs where both are made out, because it is about the victim herself.

taken.rationale: Both carry 20 to 40 years; they differ in their causes of increase. Art. 121-B adds to art. 121-A's elements a purpose aimed at a third person, and a norm with more elements is the special one. Either special article displaces art. 121 (especialidade).

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `a filha morta para punir a mãe`

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 121, § 6º

source.quote: A pena é aumentada de 1/3 (um terço) até a metade se o crime for praticado por milícia privada, sob o pretexto de prestação de serviço de segurança, ou por grupo de extermínio.

readings.description: Where § 2º-D governs (a member of an ultraviolent criminal organisation, paramilitary group or private militia, in the context of the conduct of art. 2º of Lei nº 15.358/2026), § 6º's increase for the militia's or group's action does not also apply.
§ 6º applies on top of § 2º-D's 20 to 40 years, since § 6º asks for a pretext of security or an extermination group, which § 2º-D does not.

taken.rationale: § 2º-D was enacted in 2026 with a penalty nearly double § 2º's for the action of exactly these groups; adding § 6º would count the group's action twice. The exclusion is drawn wide (any § 6º hypothesis beside § 2º-D) and a court could draw it narrower, for an extermination group that § 2º-D does not name.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `pela milícia a pretexto de segurança, no contexto do § 2º-D`

site.anchor: nos três meses posteriores ao parto (art. 121-A, § 2º, I)

source.quote: durante a gestação, nos 3 (três) meses posteriores ao parto

readings.description: From the day of the birth to the last day of three months counted, by the calendar and with the first day included (art. 10), from the day after it: a birth on 1 April makes 1 July the last day.

citations.cite: CP art. 10 — 'O dia do começo inclui-se no cômputo do prazo'

readings.description: Three months counted from the day of the birth itself, the first day included: a birth on 1 April makes 30 June the last day.

taken.rationale: 'posteriores ao parto' starts the three months after the birth, and art. 10 then counts that first day; a killing on the same-numbered day three months later is still 'nos 3 meses posteriores'. The day of the birth itself, after the delivery, is also after the birth and is included.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `três meses exatos após o parto` (1 July, increased) and `três meses e um dia após o parto` (2 July, not)

site.anchor: as razões da condição do sexo feminino alcançam o agente (art. 121-A, § 3º)

source.quote: Comunicam-se ao coautor ou partícipe as circunstâncias pessoais elementares do crime previstas no § 1º deste artigo.

readings.description: The razões of § 1º reach every co-author and participant, whether or not they were that person's own.
They reach a co-author or participant only if that person knew of them, as the general rule on the communication of elementares under art. 30 is usually read.

citations.cite: CP art. 30 — 'salvo quando elementares do crime'

readings.foreclosure: § 3º states the communication without a knowledge condition, and the case record carries no fact about the co-agent's knowledge; a court could still read one in from art. 30's doctrine.

taken.rationale: The text states the rule without qualification.

notes: The case record carries no fact about the co-agent's knowledge, so no test can tell the readings apart; `o feminicídio pelo partícipe` in cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4 shows the communication itself.

site.anchor: qualificado pelo art. 121, § 2º, III

source.quote: III - com emprego de veneno, fogo, explosivo, asfixia, tortura ou outro meio insidioso ou cruel, ou de que possa resultar perigo comum;

readings.description: Any explosive qualifies. The shared means `emprego de explosivo ou de artefato análogo que cause perigo comum` counts, and so does a local circumstance `com emprego de explosivo` for an explosive that caused no common danger.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º, III — 'explosivo', with common danger as a separate limb

readings.description: Only the shared means counts, so an explosive without common danger does not qualify under 'explosivo'.
readings.rejection_rationale: It would make 'explosivo' redundant with the inciso's last limb, 'ou de que possa resultar perigo comum', and the shared noun's wording is art. 155 § 4º-A's, not art. 121's.

taken.rationale: The inciso names the explosive by itself.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `com explosivo`
notes: A noun gap in cp-dominio.l4, not a disagreement: the conductor may prefer to hoist a plain `emprego de explosivo` into `Meio empregado`.

site.anchor: lesão corporal do art. 129, § 9º

source.quote: § 10. Nos casos previstos nos §§ 1o a 3o deste artigo, se as circunstâncias são as indicadas no § 9o deste artigo, aumenta-se a pena em 1/3 (um terço).

readings.description: §§ 9º and 13 are forms of the slight injury. A serious, very serious or fatal injury is §§ 1º to 3º's, increased by § 10 where § 9º's circumstances are present; § 13 has no such companion.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 10 — the graver results go to §§ 1º a 3º with § 9º's circumstances as an increase

readings.description: §§ 9º and 13 apply to an injury of any grade and compete with §§ 1º to 3º, the heaviest pena governing.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 9º — 'Se a lesão for praticada contra ...', no grade stated

taken.rationale: § 10 exists only if § 9º does not already reach the graver results; the other reading makes § 10 idle wherever § 9º's pena is heavier. § 13 is read the same way for coherence. The consequence, the text's own since Lei nº 14.994/2024 raised § 9º and § 13 to 2–5 years: a slight domestic injury has a higher minimum (2 years) than a serious one (§ 1º's 1 year plus a third, 16 months).

witnesses: cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `grave contra o irmão` (§ 1º with § 10) and `grave contra a mulher, por menosprezo` (§ 1º)

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 129, § 7º

source.quote: § 7o Aumenta-se a pena de 1/3 (um terço) se ocorrer qualquer das hipóteses dos §§ 4o e 6o do art. 121 deste Código.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 4º — one sentence for the culpable homicide, one for the intentional

readings.description: § 4º's first sentence (technical rule, failure to help, flight) serves the culpable injury, its second (victim under 14 or over 60) the intentional injury; § 6º's hypotheses serve either.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 4º — 'No homicídio culposo ...'; 'Sendo doloso o homicídio ...'

readings.description: Any hypothesis of § 4º increases any injury, intentional or culpable.

taken.rationale: Each hypothesis of § 4º is stated for one kind of homicide, and borrowing it carries that condition; 'fleeing to avoid arrest' after an intentional injury is a different thing from the culpable author's failure to stay. The fraction is § 7º's own 1/3, not § 6º's 1/3 to 1/2.

witnesses: cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `a culposa com fuga` (increased) and `a dolosa com fuga` (not)

site.anchor: a natureza da lesão (art. 129, §§ 1º e 2º)

source.quote: § 1º Se resulta: I - Incapacidade para as ocupações habituais, por mais de trinta dias; II - perigo de vida; III - debilidade permanente de membro, sentido ou função; IV - aceleração de parto:

readings.description: Art. 129's own rules read the incisos the medical report attests (`Consequência da lesão corporal`) and compute the grade; `a natureza da lesão` returns it as the shared `Resultado` for the articles that read that.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, §§ 1º e 2º — the grades are defined by their results

readings.description: Art. 129 reads the grade from the shared `Resultado`, as every other article does (F-g0-07).

citations.cite: cp-dominio.l4, `Resultado` — the grade as the report classifies it

taken.rationale: PLAN § 6 gives §§ 1º–2º to this group to encode from the findings; reading the grade from `Resultado` here would leave §§ 1º and 2º without an encoding. The two meet in the report, which answers both the incisos and the grade; a test asserts the mapping.

notes: Cross-reference: g0's F-g0-07 (the grade as the medical report gives it), which this entry implements for art. 129.

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 129, § 10

source.quote: Nos casos previstos nos §§ 1o a 3o deste artigo

readings.description: § 10 reaches §§ 1º, 2º and 3º, not § 3º-A.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 10 — written in 2004, before § 3º-A existed

readings.description: '§§ 1º a 3º' runs through every paragraph numbered 1 to 3, § 3º-A included.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 3º-A — numbered within the range

taken.rationale: § 3º-A was inserted with its own pena (20 to 40 years) by a law that did not touch § 10, and the same law's § 8º-A expressly keeps its increase off § 3º-A; the range read as the text had it when written.

witnesses: cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `a morte do irmão` (§ 10) and `a morte do irmão, no contexto da lei` (not)

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 129, § 12, I

source.quote: II - 2/3 (dois terços) ao dobro se a lesão dolosa for praticada nas dependências de instituição de ensino e:

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 12, I, c — 'nas dependências de instituição de ensino'

readings.description: Where II applies, the school is counted in II and I, c) is not applied again.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 12, II — the school plus a further condition

readings.description: I, c) and II both apply, in cascade.

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 129, § 11

source.quote: § 11. Na hipótese do § 9o deste artigo, a pena será aumentada de um terço se o crime for cometido contra pessoa portadora de deficiência.

readings.description: 'Na hipótese do § 9º' is the domestic setting § 9º describes: the increase applies wherever those relationships are present, the slight injury under § 9º and the graver ones under §§ 1º–3º with § 10.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 10 — 'se as circunstâncias são as indicadas no § 9º'

readings.description: Only where § 9º's own pena governs, i.e. the slight domestic injury.

taken.rationale: The other reading would increase a slight injury to a disabled relative and leave a serious one unincreased, which the text gives no reason for.

site.anchor: Circunstância do crime contra a pessoa

source.quote: integrantes do sistema prisional e da Força Nacional de Segurança Pública

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º, VII, a — '... e da Força Nacional'
CP art. 129, § 12, I, a — 'ou integrantes do sistema prisional ou da Força Nacional'

readings.description: The two alíneas name one class of victims: a member of the prison system, or of the National Force, either suffices in both articles.
Art. 121's 'e' asks for a member of both bodies at once.
readings.rejection_rationale: No one is at once a member of the prison system and of the National Force in the ordinary case; the 'e' is enumerative, as art. 129's 'ou' says.

site.anchor: a morte, se houve, é a do § 3º

source.quote: § 3° Se resulta morte e as circunstâncias evidenciam que o agente não quís o resultado, nem assumiu o risco de produzí-lo:

readings.description: An injury followed by a death the agent wanted, or whose risk the agent accepted, is not art. 129 at all but homicide (art. 121); a death from a culpable injury is art. 121 § 3º. `crime de lesão corporal (art. 129)` is FALSE for both.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 3º — the death is art. 129's only on its stated condition

readings.description: Art. 129 still answers with the grade the report gives, and the death is left to art. 121 alongside.
readings.rejection_rationale: It would answer 'lesão corporal' for a killing, and the same facts would be both art. 129's and art. 121's crime.

taken.rationale: § 3º states the condition under which a death stays within art. 129.

witnesses: cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `a morte querida` and `a morte culposa`

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 121, § 2º-B, I

source.quote: § 2º-B. A pena do homicídio contra menor de 14 (quatorze) anos é aumentada de:

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º-C — 'A pena do homicídio cometido nas dependências de instituição de ensino'

readings.description: The increases of §§ 2º-B and 2º-C go with the circumstance (inciso IX, inciso X) and apply to whichever pena governs the intentional homicide, § 2º-D's included.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º-B — 'A pena do homicídio contra menor de 14 anos'

readings.description: They apply only to § 2º's pena (12 to 30 years), the one the incisos IX and X qualify to.

taken.rationale: The paragraphs name the homicide by its victim or place, not by its pena, and § 2º-D (2026) came after them without restricting them.

site.anchor: a ação penal da lesão corporal (art. 129)

source.quote_absent_reason: The Code states no ação penal for art. 129; the question is what the external rules make of its silence.

readings.description: Slight (caput, and §§ 9º and 13, which are its forms) and culpable (§ 6º) injuries need representação under Lei 9.099 art. 88; where the injury results from domestic and family violence against a woman, Lei 11.340 art. 41 disapplies Lei 9.099 and the action is pública incondicionada (STJ Súmula 542). Every other form is pública incondicionada.
The Code states no condition, so art. 100's default (pública incondicionada) governs every form of art. 129.
readings.rejection_rationale: Lei 9.099 art. 88 conditions the action for slight and culpable injuries 'além das hipóteses do Código Penal'.

taken.rationale: The statutes and the súmula decide the core. The open edge the sweep flagged — § 9º against a man, and § 13 outside a domestic setting — is decided here by the grade of the INJURY: art. 88 says 'lesões corporais leves', a grade, and both are slight injuries, so both need representação unless the violence is domestic and family violence against a woman. The alternative, that art. 88 is about the band of penalty (Lei 9.099's 'menor potencial ofensivo'), would make both unconditional; no authority on it was fetched.

witnesses: cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `a lesão leve` (condicionada), `contra a esposa, em violência doméstica` (incondicionada), `contra o irmão` and `contra a mulher, por menosprezo` (the open edge, condicionada)
notes: The súmula settles the domestic-violence-against-a-woman arm; the open edge is the encoder's reading and is listed among the open questions in notes/g2a.md.

site.anchor: Circunstância do crime contra a pessoa

source.quote: I – violência doméstica e familiar;

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 13 — 'nos termos do § 1º do art. 121-A'

readings.description: Lei 11.340 art. 5º's definition: a gender-based act in the domestic unit, the family, or any intimate relationship, 'independentemente de coabitação' (STJ Súmula 600).
The Code's own list in art. 129 § 9º (ascendant, descendant, sibling, spouse or partner, domestic worker, cohabitant, relations of hospitality).
readings.foreclosure: 'violência doméstica e familiar' is Lei 11.340's term of art, and § 9º does not use it; § 9º reaches relationships (a brother, a guest) that are not the gender-based violence the phrase names.

taken.rationale: The phrase is Lei 11.340's; the fact supplier certifies that the crime involves violence of that kind, cohabitation not required. It is kept apart from `menosprezo ou discriminação à condição de mulher` and from art. 129 § 9º's relationships, as the proposed fork asked.

site.anchor: o crime de matar que os fatos constituem (arts. 121 a 121-B e 123)

source.quote: Art. 123 - Matar, sob a influência do estado puerperal, o próprio filho, durante o parto ou logo após:

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º, IX — 'contra menor de 14 (quatorze) anos'

readings.description: Where the facts make out art. 123 it governs the death, before arts. 121-B, 121-A and 121; a newborn is under fourteen, but § 2º IX does not turn the mother's puerperal killing into a qualified homicide.

citations.cite: CP art. 123 — the special, privileged form of killing one's own child

readings.description: Since 2022 the killing of a child under fourteen is qualified homicide (12 to 30 years), and that reaches the newborn too.
readings.rejection_rationale: It would leave art. 123 without a case: every newborn is under fourteen. The special norm prevails over the general one (especialidade).

taken.rationale: Especialidade; the other reading empties art. 123.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `o infanticídio` (art. 123) and `sem o estado puerperal` (art. 121 § 2º)
notes: The participation of a third party in an infanticide (does the puerperal state, an elementar, communicate under art. 30?) is not modelled: the record describes the mother's conduct.

site.anchor: o crime pelo qual responde o agente (art. 122)

source.quote: responde o agente pelo crime de homicídio, nos termos do art. 121 deste Código.

citations.cite: CP art. 122, § 6º — 'responde o agente pelo crime descrito no § 2º do art. 129'

readings.description: The agent answers for the other crime under that crime's own rules in full: art. 121's qualifications and causes (§ 2º IX for a victim under fourteen) and art. 129's causes (§ 7º for a victim under fourteen) apply to the same facts.

The victim's age or vulnerability, which is what sends the agent to the other crime, is not used again to qualify or increase it: § 7º gives homicide under art. 121's caput unless another circumstance qualifies it.

citations.cite: CP art. 122, §§ 6º e 7º — the vulnerability is the condition of the displacement

taken.rationale: The text sends the agent to the other crime 'nos termos' of its article, and says nothing to exclude any of its rules. Recorded with the alternative because it counts the victim's age twice (once to displace, once to qualify), which the encoding avoided in F-g2a-03 for art. 121 alone; a court could take the second reading.

witnesses: cp-g2a-suicidio-testes.l4: `Júlia, morte` (art. 121 § 2º by inciso IX) and `Júlia, lesão gravíssima` (art. 129 § 7º)

site.anchor: a ADPF 54 exclui o fato do tipo

source.quote: Mostra-se inconstitucional interpretação de a interrupção da gravidez de feto anencéfalo ser conduta tipificada nos artigos 124, 126 e 128, incisos I e II, do Código Penal.

citations.cite: STF, ADPF 54, Rel. Marco Aurélio, Tribunal Pleno, j. 12.4.2012, DJe 30.4.2013 (ementa as reproduced by TJDFT)

readings.description: The reading-down governs facts from the judgment (12.4.2012); an earlier fact is judged by the text as enacted.

citations.cite: M-sweep-b-01's proposed arm: 'arts. 124, 126 e 128 lidos conforme ADPF 54 (2012-04-12)'

readings.description: A declaration that a reading is unconstitutional reaches back to every fact not finally judged, and a reading that decriminalises applies retroactively in any case (art. 2º of the Code).

site.anchor: o aborto não é punido (art. 128)

source.quote: Art. 128 - Não se pune o aborto praticado por médico:

readings.description: 'Não se pune o aborto': the abortion itself, so no participant is punished — the woman who consented (art. 124) as well as the doctor (arts. 125, 126); inciso I, which asks no consent, reaches art. 125 too.

citations.cite: CP art. 128 — the subject is 'o aborto', not 'o médico'

readings.description: Only the doctor is not punished; the woman who consented still answers under art. 124.
readings.rejection_rationale: The same act cannot be lawful for the doctor who performs it and criminal for the woman who consents to it; the article's subject is the abortion.

source.quote: são aumentadas de um terço, se, em conseqüência do aborto ou dos meios empregados para provocá-lo, a gestante sofre lesão corporal de natureza grave; e são duplicadas, se, por qualquer dessas causas, lhe sobrevém a morte.

readings.description: Where the woman dies, the penalty is doubled; an injury she suffered on the way to death does not add the third as well.

citations.cite: CP art. 127 — two alternatives, graded by the result

readings.description: Both increases apply, in cascade, where she was seriously injured and died.
readings.rejection_rationale: The death is the graver stage of the same harm; counting the injury and the death is counting one course of events twice.

readings.description: Absent a finding, the fact is taken not to be a graver crime.

site.anchor: crime de omissão de socorro (art. 135)

source.quote: Deixar de prestar assistência, quando possível fazê-lo sem risco pessoal, ...; ou não pedir, nesses casos, o socorro da autoridade pública:

readings.description: Where help was possible without personal risk, the duty is to give it, and asking the authority does not discharge it; where it was not possible, the duty is to ask the authority. The crime is failing the duty that applied.

citations.cite: CP art. 135 — 'quando possível fazê-lo sem risco pessoal' qualifies the first conduct; 'nesses casos' the second

readings.description: The two are alternatives: one who asked the authority committed no omission, even if they could have helped directly.

taken.rationale: 'quando possível fazê-lo sem risco pessoal' marks when direct help is owed; the call to the authority is the duty that remains when it is not. The alternative makes a phone call a licence not to help a child one could have picked up; a court could still hold it.

site.anchor: ocorre morte ou lesão corporal de natureza grave (art. 137, parágrafo único)

source.quote: Se ocorre morte ou lesão corporal de natureza grave, aplica-se, pelo fato da participação na rixa, a pena de detenção, de seis meses a dois anos.

readings.description: Every participant answers under the parágrafo único, whoever suffered the result and whether or not they had left before it, except one who joined only after it occurred.

citations.cite: CP art. 137, parágrafo único — 'pelo fato da participação na rixa'

readings.description: Every participant, including one who joined after the result: the text asks only that a death or injury 'ocorre' in the rixa.

site.anchor: a vítima é a do art. 135

source.quote: à criança abandonada ou extraviada, ou à pessoa inválida ou ferida, ao desamparo ou em grave e iminente perigo

readings.description: Three cases: a child abandoned or lost; an invalid or injured person left helpless; any person in grave and imminent danger.
'ao desamparo ou em grave e iminente perigo' qualifies all the others, so a lost child is a victim only if also helpless or in danger.
readings.rejection_rationale: An abandoned or lost child is helpless by the description itself; and read so, a healthy adult in grave danger would not be protected at all.

taken.rationale: The reading that protects each class the words name. 'criança' is cp-pena's, under twelve (F-g0-24).

site.anchor: o autor é ascendente, padrasto ou madrasta, tio, irmão, cônjuge, companheiro, tutor, curador, preceptor ou empregador da vítima, ou tem autoridade sobre ela

source.quote: II - 2/3 (dois terços) se o autor é ascendente, padrasto ou madrasta, tio, irmão, cônjuge, companheiro, tutor, curador, preceptor ou empregador da vítima ou por qualquer outro título tiver autoridade sobre ela.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º-C, II and art. 129, § 12, II, b — the same clause

readings.description: 'por qualquer outro título tiver autoridade sobre ela' reaches whoever has the victim in their custody, care or supervision (cp-dominio's `guarda, cuidado ou vigilância da vítima`) — a nanny, a babysitter, a day-care worker — as well as any other recorded authority (`outra relação de autoridade sobre a vítima`).

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º-B, II — a generic clause after a list of examples (preceptor, empregador) that are not family: interpretation by analogy inside the law, not analogy against the accused

readings.description: 'autoridade' is narrower than custody, care or supervision: the Code names them apart ('sob seu cuidado, guarda, vigilância ou autoridade', art. 133; 'sob sua autoridade, guarda ou vigilância', art. 136), so only a recorded relation of authority counts, and a lifeguard or a bus monitor supervising a child does not.

taken.rationale: The clause is open by its own words ('qualquer outro título'), and the examples before it include relations of mere position (preceptor, employer), so extending it to one who holds the child in custody or care follows the text. This is not the extension refused in F-g2a-29: art. 133 § 3º II closes its list with no generic clause. The narrower reading is strong for mere 'vigilância', which the shared noun lumps with custody and care; a lawyer should say whether the noun should be split.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `Helena, sob a guarda da babá, aos 13` and `na escola, por quem tinha a vítima sob sua vigilância`
cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `na escola, por quem tinha a vítima sob sua guarda`
notes: Raised by the independent test pass (ta-g2), 2026-09-30. Before this fork the clause read only `outra relação de autoridade sobre a vítima`.
